## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Sevilla, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5.0 km. It starts at Setas de Sevilla, Pl. de la Encarnación, s/n, Casco Antiguo, 41003 Sevilla, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Setas de Sevilla. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided walking tour is perfect for first-time travelers eager to explore Seville’s architectural wonders, historic treasures, and lively plazas. A ticket to the stunning Setas de Sevilla is included, offering a memorable start to your journey. Please note that the audio guide inside Setas de Sevilla is not provided.
>
> Your journey begins at Setas de Sevilla, the city’s modern wooden marvel, and meanders through its vibrant streets. Highlights include the majestic Church of the Divine Saviour, the bustling Plaza Nueva, the historic Plaza de Toros, and the iconic Torre del Oro. You’ll wander the green paths of María Luisa Park, revel in the grandeur of Plaza de España, and finish at the Royal Alcázar, a sumptuous Moorish palace that encapsulates Seville’s rich history.
>
> Throughout the route, discover breathtaking views, intricate ceramic tile artwork, and landmarks steeped in centuries of tradition. Whether admiring the panoramic cityscape from the Setas or standing beneath the towering splendor of La Giralda, the experiences will be unforgettable.
